messages:
anna: Kicking off staged drip for release v3.2.1 — US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Can SRE confirm warm-pool counts and thermal headroom?

deploy-bot: Deploy plan uploaded by anna. Scheduled start 02:05 UTC. Configuration: 3-stage rollout, canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

sam: US checks: warm pool 40/50 GPUs, warm pool memory headroom ~18%. KV cache primed for top prefixes. Smoke tests (quick-gen) passed.

marco: EU snapshot: warm pool 18/30 GPUs, 95th latency currently 220ms (target 200ms). If we push full traffic, expect 10-15% p95 rise without additional warm-up. Recommend EU pinned fallback to v3.2.0 ready.

anna: Plan: kick off US canary at 02:05 UTC with 10% traffic for 15m. If stable, promote to 50% at 02:25 and hold 30m. EU warmup to start 03:10 UTC, but keep EU pinned to v3.2.0 until EU holdpoint passes. APAC wait until EU is green.

izzy: Canary routing snippet I pushed to deploy config:```yaml
canary:
  header: X-Rollout
  value: canary
  percent: 10
models:
  - v3.2.1
```

deploy-bot: canary applied to us-1, source=release-manager/anna, commit=abc123def, started=4970012345

oncall: Runbook check: If EU p95 > 250ms OR error_rate > 0.7% during hold => trigger rollback-eu. Rollback steps: 1) pause rollout, 2) route EU traffic to v3.2.0, 3) notify support, 4) open incident if retries fail.

sam: Quick smoke commands I ran:```bash
# warm pool status
redwoodctl pools list --region us-1
# smoke generate
redwoodctl infer --model v3.2.1 --prompt "status check" --count 50
# sample output
# latency p95 48ms, error_rate 0.0%
```

marco: I'll pre-stage EU fallback pins: creating rollout pin config now so deploy-bot can flip immediately if needed.

izzy: Release notes (short):
- v3.2.1: improved KV cache eviction, reduced token mem for quantized models, bugfix for streaming dropout.
- Notes: EU will be pinned to v3.2.0 during initial rollout; full EU ramp requires post-hold warmup. Link PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/release-notes/pull/432

anna: Also adding a short support blurb for change window: "Expect brief rate-limited increases during canary promotion windows. Contact oncall if any user-facing regression."

oncall: Support notified and standby. If deploy-bot posts any automated rollback flags, paging will escalate to pager rotation.

deploy-bot: monitor: cpu_util_us_1=62%, gpu_warm_us_1=40/50, error_rate_us_1=0.03%, p95_us_1=50ms

anna: ACK. I'll post updates at each holdpoint (02:20, 02:55, 03:40). Proceeding with 02:05 canary now. :rocket:

sam: 02:10 quick status: US canary stable. No anomalies.

marco: EU warmup queued for 03:10. Keeping fallback pin ready.

izzy: Pushed the release-note PR and the deploy config. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/deploys/abc123

anna: Thanks all — close loop on final window notes after APAC completes.
